title: Tell merged, released and enabled apart
statement: As a product manager, I can see whether a story in a release is merged, released and turned on, so I do not announce something users cannot use yet.
overview: Proposed addition. Existing flags already report `implemented_not_enabled`; a checklist step can tell someone to flip one, but the tool does not flip it.

acceptance_criteria.statement: A release's page shows, for each story, whether a merged review was found, whether the release is marked released, and the current state of any flag gating the story.
A story in a released release whose flag is off is shown as released but not enabled.
A story with no flag shows no flag state rather than reading as enabled by a flag.
